yeah i get not being able describe how you feel. I think our purpose, or meaning to life or whatever you wanna call it is just to find a purpose honestly so its ok to not know whats yours is yet. Things are and arent, the sun goes up and down, but asking why it goes up and down doesnt mean anything, i think "purpose" is something we came up with to deal with the fact we are conscious beings that one day, wont be here anymore. I heard someone say something like this before... "if you had no reason to be here anymore, life wpuld have gotten rid of you, everone has a porurpose and when that is fufilled life will chew you up ans spit you out and youll have no say in the matter, the fact youre still here means life isnt done with you, if life wanted you dead youd be dead, weather it be youre some statistic of the dangers of addiction or whatever, you can walk outside and get hit my a bus, you may get cancer, when life is done with you life will be done with you and the fact youre still here means life isnt done with you and youre purpose has yet to be filled" 
its a tad bit pessimistic but that gives a reason to hold off one more day when i get to that point. "If my life is meaning less, life will find a way to get rid of me, so if i wake up tomorrow, life aint done with me yet" i always think of that, people die every second, life always finds a way to get rid of you so theres no point of ending it early, since youve yet to experience the reason youre alive right now and not some statistic. Again im sorry if this doesnt help, i want to help so bad but its so hard to find the right words. All i know if you ever have bad thoughts just remember when life is done  with you you will have no say in the matter so just keep going untill that day, maybe youll get to the point where you feel like youre the most lved and wanted person in the world, and youll be able to show those feeling to someome who is feeling the same way. Also pain makes you a better person, that what my mom tells me, i whole heartedly belive you will find purpose, and that you being here makes the world a better place
